about: The officer at the guard post's window halfway along the prisoner tunnel (plans/tunnel.gd). Placeholder lines written on 2026-11-15 by the civic worker, not the owners' wording. Format: see scripts/talk_box.gd.

place.speaker: npc
place.line: The walk. Cells to court and back, single file, on the line.

through.speaker: npc
through.line: Gates stay shut. You open one, you shut it behind you.

quiet.speaker: npc
quiet.line: Till the pipes start banging. Then everybody jumps.
